<Picture 1> 写实人像摄影，20岁出头东亚年轻女性，半身构图，正面朝向镜头，表情平静柔和。黑色长发，空气刘海，头发编成两条松散的麻花辫垂在双肩前。佩戴夸张的金色花朵造型吊坠耳环（带水晶垂坠），细银链项链。身穿米香槟色提花针织露肩连衣裙，面料有叶脉状压纹肌理，头后披着同色系薄纱头巾如松垮兜帽。室内暖光，一侧带粉紫色轮廓光，背景为虚化的暖米色现代公寓走廊。珊瑚色水光唇，清透淡妆，深色双眼直视镜头。85mm人像镜头，浅景深，真实皮肤质感，韩系/国风美女写真风格，高清4K。

<Picture 2> 写实人像摄影，20岁出头东亚年轻女性，半身构图，身体微侧，脸朝镜头，温柔浅笑。深棕色长发半扎公主头，发尾大波浪卷垂在双肩，中分带修饰脸型的碎发。精致淡妆：柔和棕色眉、细眼线、玫瑰粉水光唇、白皙水光肌。身穿黑色短款双排扣西装上衣，深V领带纽扣，露出腰线，搭配黑色高腰百褶长裤。场景：夜晚昏暗的现代办公室/游戏工作室，背景两台电脑显示器亮着彩色游戏画面，桌上一把橙色背光机械键盘，身后有灰色柜子和一扇开着的门。整个房间笼罩冷调蓝紫色环境光，脸部有柔和暖色主光形成冷暖对比。50mm镜头，浅景深，背景虚化，电影感夜景氛围，高清4K。

用 <Picture 1> 替换参考视频里那个清瘦的中国男子，二十多岁，黑色略长碎发自然刘海，戴窄框复古深色墨镜，身穿闪亮的银蓝色修身西装套装，内搭酒红色衬衫，系一条垂到西装下摆以下的浅粉色印花长领带，一手抬起做舞蹈姿势，侧头看向女伴，表情痞帅带笑。

用 <Picture 2> 替换参考视频里那个高挑纤细的中国女子，黑发梳高髻戴细发箍，低头害羞浅笑，穿宽松深色大圆领七分袖针织上衣露出锁骨，下身穿黑底大朵红色民族花纹印花短裙，一手叉腰正在跳舞。
背景：地面，机位、景别、景深和镜头运动全部按参考视频来，画面从头到尾都是这个场景里的干净画面；参考视频是在舞台中央跳舞的画面，视频开始是 <Picture 1> 的替换对象在画面左侧牵着右侧同伴的人慢慢走向前方，<Picture 2> 的替换对象在画面右侧，音频整轨 1:1 保留。

<Subject 1> is the young woman in <Picture 1>, preserving her facial identity, long black hair with wispy air bangs in two loose braids draped over her shoulders, large gold flower-cluster earrings with crystal drops, layered silver necklace, and beige champagne textured knit off-shoulder dress with a matching veil behind her head.
<Subject 2> is the young woman in <Picture 2>, preserving her facial identity, long dark brown half-up hair with face-framing waves, natural elegant makeup, and a black cropped double-breasted V-neck top with matching high-waist black trousers.
<Video 1> is the 8.5-second source clip of a couple dancing on a retro stage, providing the action order, camera moves, framing, timing, stage environment and the comedic facial-expression finale.
<Audio 1> is the copied source music track, the retro dance score that plays continuously across the target video.
summary:
[video editing + reference generation + audio reuse] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1> in which the man in the shiny suit and sunglasses is replaced by <Subject 1> and the woman in the wine-red top is replaced by <Subject 2>. It opens on a tilted wide view of the black-and-white checkerboard dance floor under red LED beams, then the two women walk toward each other across the checker floor, close into a behind-the-back dance embrace with her arm extended, and end in a tight two-shot where the front woman performs an exaggerated comedic surprised face while the woman behind leans in close. The stage, checkerboard floor, LED background, lighting, camera language, timing and <Audio 1> are kept unchanged; only the two dancers' original faces, the sunglasses, the silver-blue suit, the wine-red top and the ethnic print skirt are not kept.
retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - her facial identity, air bangs, twin braids, gold flower earrings and beige knit dress from <Picture 1> are retained exactly while she performs the source clip's behind-the-back embrace and lean-in comedy beats; the original sunglasses are not transferred to her.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5]): fully_preserved - her facial identity, half-up long hair and black cropped V-neck outfit from <Picture 2> are retained exactly while she performs the source clip's front-dancer actions and the exaggerated surprised facial expression.
<Video 1>: partially_preserved - the action order, camera moves, framing, timing, tilted wide angle, black-and-white checkerboard dance floor, giant red kaleidoscope LED screen, neon palm-tree props, red spotlights and white side beams are retained, while the original performers' faces, the sunglasses, the silver-blue suit, the wine-red top and the ethnic floral skirt are not retained and are not reproduced.
<Audio 1>: fully_copy - <Audio 1> is reused as the complete continuous background music of the target video, unchanged.
detailed_description:
The target video keeps the source clip's early-2000s Hong Kong film stage aesthetic: the black-and-white checkerboard dance floor, the giant LED screen radiating red kaleidoscope patterns, neon palm-tree props, red spotlights with white side beams, soft haze and film grain; only the two dancers are replaced. No subtitles, captions or watermark appear anywhere in the frame. The two subjects keep strictly distinct faces and never swap. <Audio 1> plays from the first frame to the last.
[Shot 1] From 00:00.000 to 00:01.200, a Dutch-angled wide view shows the gleaming checkerboard stage with red LED beams and neon palms; <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> appear as two small figures entering from opposite sides, walking toward each other.
[Shot 2] From 00:01.200 to 00:03.000, the camera levels to a wide frontal view: <Subject 1>, braids and beige knit dress from <Picture 1> catching the light, and <Subject 2> in her black cropped V-neck outfit from <Picture 2>, stride toward each other across the checker floor, the red kaleidoscope screen glowing behind them.
[Shot 3] From 00:03.000 to 00:05.000, a medium shot as they join into the source's dance hold: <Subject 1> steps in close behind <Subject 2>, wrapping one arm around her waist while <Subject 2> extends her other arm outward in the classic pose, both swaying under red spotlights with white beams flaring at the frame edges.
[Shot 4] From 00:05.000 to 00:06.800, the framing tightens to a two-shot close on their faces: <Subject 2> throws an exaggerated comedic surprised expression, mouth open and eyes wide, while <Subject 1> leans in just behind her cheek with a pursed-lip playful face, her gold flower earrings swinging.
[Shot 5] From 00:06.800 to 00:08.450, still tight on <Subject 2>'s face, she turns her gaze sharply to the side with a mock-fierce pout as <Subject 1>'s blurred figure continues leaning close behind her; the clip ends on this held comedic beat as <Audio 1> carries through the final frame.
overall_soundscape:
The copied source audio carries the full retro dance music; faint hall reverb and a light crowd presence sit under the music without altering it.
non_diegetic_music:
<Audio 1> is the continuous source music track, a retro orchestral-dance number that drives the whole clip unchanged.
